title: Floating (un-awaited) action

lean.excerpt: Await this action; un-awaited, the test moves on before it finishes and its failure is lost.

peter.excerpt: await `page.getByTestId("panel.save--button").click()`: an action that is not awaited runs past the next line.

title: Conditional on awaited page state

lean.excerpt: Branching on awaited page state hides which path the test took; set the state up and assert it.

peter.excerpt: A test branches on awaited page state here, so what it ran depends on timing. Know the state the test is in and assert it; only a navigation walk ("get to X from wherever I am") may branch.

title: expect.soft()

lean.excerpt: expect.soft() lets the test continue after a failure; use expect().

peter.excerpt: `expect.soft` lets the test go on after it failed. Use `expect`, so the first failure is the one reported.

title: toHaveURL("/path") drops server subpath

lean.excerpt: toHaveURL() with a path drops the server subpath; assert with toHavePath(pages.<page>.pathFor(...)) and the page ready part.

peter.excerpt: Assert where the test is through the page object: `expect(page).toHavePath(app.<page>.pathFor(params))` (subpath-aware), and `app.<page>.ready[0]` visible when the test needs the page rendered. Write `toHaveURL` only where the URL is the subject (a redirect target, a query parameter), with a reason.
